name: agenting
description: Route every subagent to the right model and effort — and get asked before a workflow spends.

plugins.name: agenting
plugins.description: A PreToolUse gate that refuses to run a Workflow until every agent() call carries an explicit model and effort, and in manual mode asks you to approve the routing plan. Warns when a finished Workflow lost agents, keeps per-project routing rules, and ships 20 tiered agent definitions and a health check.
